title: Makai Lemon: "For sure" I'll be up to speed for Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Makai Lemon: "For sure" I'll be up to speed for Week 1
sources.description: Eagles wide receiver Makai Lemon returned to practice last week after an extended absence due to a hamstring injury and the rookie is confident that he'll have enough practice time to be at full speed for the season opener.
